name: Auto short qr
description: Adds computed self-referencing short-URL and QR/barcode fields (with UTM tagging) to node, user, taxonomy term and redirect entities, using drupal/barcodes.
project_description: Auto short qr adds two computed link fields — a self-referencing short URL and a self-referencing QR/barcode — to node, user, taxonomy term and (optionally) redirect entities. Enable per bundle from a third-party 'Autocode' section injected into the type/settings forms. The module registers short routes (/ns, /nc, /uc, /tc, /rc, etc.) that decode a base36 entity id and redirect to the entity's canonical URL, plus /autoshortqr/* download routes that stream the QR as an SVG. Per-type UTM parameters (source/medium/campaign/content/term, token-aware) are appended to the resolved URL. Requires drupal/barcodes (and the tecnickcom/tc-lib-barcode library) for QR/barcode rendering.
